scope: Offline Stage 3 only. No confidence interval, optimization, or walk-forward calculation.

delta_neutral_check.rule: spot_pnl + futures_pnl equals basis_pnl within engine tolerance for every complete ledger row

lookahead_audit.entry_exit_prices: spot/futures 1m open after the funding event that triggered the decision
lookahead_audit.signal_data: rolling mean of current and two prior realized funding records only
lookahead_audit.exit_funding: included for a position already active before the event
